top.why: INVERSION on USDCx: supply Zest V2 1.28% vs borrow Granite 1.15%
top.text:
USDCx is inverted across venues.

Supplying at Zest V2 pays 1.28%. Borrowing the same asset at Granite costs 1.15%.

+13 bps, before fees, gas and liquidation risk.

sbor.xyz
